## Quality Checklist

- [ ] Code is split into readable, focused modules/functions/components.
- [ ] Comments explain non-obvious behavior or safety constraints only.
- [ ] Configuration lives in the correct config/env/template files.
- [ ] No secrets, credentials, local tokens, or ignored runtime files are committed.
- [ ] The change follows the existing project structure and naming patterns.
- [ ] Relevant lint, type-check, unit, and live/smoke checks have been run.
